summary: frontend-orb preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: The npm preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases to a temp directory, chmod+x's it, and invokes it against `math_init.js`, a 727KB obfuscated bundle shipped in the tarball. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers in setup.mjs; rotating string-array cipher with a >1000-entry constant array in math_init.js). The package.json declares `main: index.js` but that file is absent from the tarball; the README describes a CircleCI orb that aggregates frontend CI yml commands, and the only legitimate assets are yml orb definitions under src/. The alternate-runtime execution path (invoking Bun rather than Node on the payload) is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to bypass Node-based static analysis. The advertised CI-orb purpose does not require executing an obfuscated 727KB bundle under a downloaded second language runtime at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
